versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Moving Checklist skill.
- Generates reverse chronological moving plans with box labeling, utility transfers, and detailed timelines.
- Provides three separate lists for fragile/valuable items, must-carry essentials, and “last packed, first unpacked” supplies.
- Includes address change procedures, handover checks, and specific risk reminders.
- Adapts output based on move date, home size, use of movers, city/cross-city moves, and presence of pets or children.
- Ensures no legal opinions or DIY guidance on gas/electrical work; advises users to consult professionals.
